question: Which of the following institutes got the first rank in the Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements (ARIIA) 2020 in the category of ‘Institute of National Importance?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Indian Institute of Technology Madras__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2020 edition of the Atal Rankings of Institutions on Innovation Achievements (ARIIA)** has been published.
 
• The ranking is announced virtually due to the COVID-19 epidemic. IIT-Madras has been named the top institute in the category of institutes of national importance.
 
• According to the official release, ARIIA 2020 features a separate prize category for women-only higher educational institutions for the first time.
 
• Centrally supported institutions, state-funded universities, state-funded autonomous institutions, private/deemed universities, and private institutions are the remaining five groups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• IIT Madras (previously known as Madras Institute of Technology) is a public technical and research university in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It is designated as an Institute of National Importance since it is one of the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs).
 
• It was the third IIT created by the Government of India, and it was founded in 1959 with technical and financial aid from the former government of West Germany.
